journey.name: Preserve timer across Activity recreation
journey.description: Use a dedicated test profile with freshly provisioned app data, default four-cycle settings and automatic starts disabled; do not reset or clear a user's personal app data. Enable device auto-rotation in the test environment. Verify rotation preserves running and paused time without inserting history records, then cancel the sequence explicitly.

actions.action: Verify that 'Foco' and the timer value '25:00' are visible
Tap 'Iniciar'
If the 'Receber avisos de sessão' dialog appears, tap 'Permitir'
If Android asks for notification permission, allow notifications
Wait 5 seconds
Remember the remaining time shown by the timer
Rotate the device to landscape orientation
Verify that 'Foco' and the 'Pausar' button are visible
Verify that the timer is lower than the remembered time and has not reset to '25:00'
Tap 'Pausar'
Remember the remaining time shown by the timer
Rotate the device back to portrait orientation
Verify that the 'Continuar' button is visible
Verify that the remaining time is unchanged
Tap 'Histórico'
Tap the 'Hoje' period chip
Verify that 'Nenhuma sessão ainda' is visible
Tap 'Pomodoro'
Verify that the remaining time is unchanged
Tap 'Continuar'
Verify that the 'Pausar' button is visible
Tap 'Cancelar Pomodoro'
Tap 'Continuar sessão' inside the confirmation dialog
Verify that 'Foco' and 'Pausar' are still visible
Tap 'Cancelar Pomodoro'
Tap 'Cancelar Pomodoro' inside the confirmation dialog
Verify that 'Foco', '25:00', 'Ciclo 1 de 4' and 'Iniciar' are visible
